ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_margin_with_bias_and_clip_normalized_repaired
ir.intuition: Add stable normalization using sum of weights instead of sum of weighted loss to avoid division by zero and ensure numerical stability; preserve original pairwise margin with bias clipping and normalization.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
abs_delta_rank_mean = mean(abs(delta_rank)) + 1e-6
gamma = extra.get('gamma', 1.5)
beta = 0.05 * abs_delta_rank_mean
weighted_margin = alpha * margin - beta * delta_rank
biased_margin = weighted_margin + gamma * bias
x = clamp(biased_margin, -10, 10)
loss_per_pair = -logsigmoid(x)
weighted_loss = loss_per_pair * weight
norm = sum(weight) + epsilon
loss = sum(weighted_loss) / norm
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    bias = float(extra.get('bias', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('bias', 0.5)))
    gamma = float(extra.get('gamma', 1.5))

    abs_delta_rank_mean = ops.mean(ops.abs(delta_rank)) + 1e-6
    beta = 0.05 * abs_delta_rank_mean

    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    weighted_margin = ops.sub(ops.mul(alpha, margin), ops.mul(beta, delta_rank))
    biased_margin = ops.add(weighted_margin, ops.mul(gamma, bias))
    x = ops.clamp(biased_margin, -10.0, 10.0)
    loss_per_pair = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)
    norm = ops.sum(weight) + eps
    loss = ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_loss), norm)
    return loss
